FAQ

Questions? We've got answers

  • ThinxDigital is a Sydney-based performance paid media agency. We plan, run and optimise online advertising on Google, Microsoft Bing, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube and other platforms, with one goal: growing our clients' sales and leads.

  • No. We're based in Sydney and work with businesses across Australia and overseas. We also run campaigns in international markets for clients who sell globally.

  • Mainly lead generation businesses, such as service and healthcare providers, and e-commerce brands. We also work with digital and information product businesses. Many of our clients have worked with us for five years or more.

  • Diego Sanchez, ThinxDigital's founder, personally manages every client account. He has more than 15 years' experience in performance advertising, and there are no account managers in between.

  • Every client gets a live online dashboard connected to all of their ad platforms, showing results in real time. You also get clear, honest updates on what's working, what isn't and what we're changing.

  • AI tools make it easy to launch campaigns, but making them profitable takes more: understanding your margins, seasonality and competitors, knowing which data to trust, and knowing when a platform's automated recommendations serve the platform rather than your business. We use AI to work faster, combined with more than 15 years of hands-on experience.

  • Management fees start from $450 per month, plus your ad spend. The final fee depends on your business and goals, the level of attention needed, your advertising investment, and the framework and effort involved. After an initial call, you'll get a clear quote.

  • Book a call through the contact form. We'll learn about your business and goals, then agree on a clear plan covering your sales or lead targets, budget and how success will be measured.
